story_type: woman missing for days found on a steep coastal slope above the surf, helicopter hoist
hook: She was missing for five days. The only way out was up.
narration: She was missing for five days. The only way out was straight up.
Her husband finally found her, on the coast near Florence, Oregon.
A fire crew had already tried to reach her, but the shoreline was too steep.
So police called a Coast Guard crew from North Bend.
The rescue swimmer rode the cable down to her.
A hoist can lift someone from ground no rope team can safely stand on.
outcome: The crew lifted her aboard and flew her to medics on Highway 101. She was in stable condition.
title: Missing 5 days on the Oregon coast
description:
A woman missing for five days was found by her husband on steep terrain along the shoreline near Florence, Oregon. After a fire crew could not reach her, a Coast Guard Sector North Bend MH-65 Dolphin crew hoisted her on Aug. 16, 2017.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Sector North Bend, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/544370/woman-missing-5-days-found-safe-hoisted-coast-guard-helo-near-florence-oregon

facts.claim: Missing for five days before her husband found her
facts.source_quote: The woman was reported missing for 5 days before her husband found her and reported her location to local emergency responders

facts.claim: A fire department crew could not reach her because of steep terrain
facts.source_quote: A local fire department crew previously made an unsuccessful rescue attempt due to steep terrain along the shoreline

facts.claim: Sector North Bend MH-65 crew took her to EMS waiting on Highway 101
facts.source_quote: An aircrew aboard an MH-65 Dolphin helicopter from Sector North Bend transports a woman safely to an emergency medical service crew waiting on Highway 101 near Sea Lion Caves in Florence, Oregon, Aug. 16, 2017
She was reportedly in stable condition at the time of the rescue
